d: Matriarch Nettie Stanley worries that her sister Mellie's stripping and fighting are getting out of hand  Mellie's ex-boyfriend Robbie comes back into town  Kayla's trip to the racetrack is derailed by Mellie's drinking.

st: All is Fair in Gypsy War
